g.title: public.organizations
g.text: Tenant root. Single row today; every domain table hangs off organization_id for future multi-tenancy.

g.title: public.staff_locations:location_id->public.locations:id
g.text: FOREIGN KEY (location_id) REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

g.title: public.resources
g.text: Concrete rooms per location. Inactive rooms leave bookable inventory immediately.

g.title: public.availability_rules
g.text: Recurring weekly hours in LOCATION-LOCAL time (survives DST). Overlaps per staff/day are impossible: no_overlapping_hours exclusion constraint (timerange custom type).

g.title: public.appointments
g.text: Never deleted — status lifecycle only (booked→confirmed→checked_in→in_progress→completed | cancelled | no_show). Double-booking of staff or rooms is impossible: gist exclusion constraints on the blocked window, which ignore cancelled/no_show rows so slots free themselves.
Start of the FULL blocked window including buffer_before — what all conflict checks use.
